Wanted mission: 3–5 hours; addons: down to luck (rare drops, 20 h cooldown per boss) or the Market

The {wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfits} are the garments of the citizens of Issavi, in {wiki:Kilmaresh|Kilmaresh}. The base outfit is the reward for the **Wanted** mission of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest|Kilmaresh Quest}: you find out which of the four wanted people is innocent and defeat the other three on your own ({creature:Neferi the Spy}, {creature:Sister Hetai} and {creature:Amenef the Burning}). The two addons are earned by using an {item:Eye-Embroidered Veil} and a {item:Tagralt-Inlaid Scabbard}, rare drops from those same three bosses (or bought from other players on the Market). With both addons you receive the achievement **Citizen of Issavi**.

The addon items are **very rare** (between 0.17% and 1.5% per boss). Both can be traded on the **Market**, so buying them from another player is often the fastest way.
Each fugitive has a **20-hour** cooldown: after the mission you can face them again whenever the cooldown ends, to try for the drops.
The three bosses take **more ice damage**: {creature:Sister Hetai} 125%, {creature:Amenef the Burning} 120% and {creature:Neferi the Spy} 110%.

Have the {item:Ivory Mask} and the {item:Secret Agent Tools|Secret Agent Tool} (or {item:Obsidian Knife}) with you before going to the shrine: if you scrape the mirror without wearing the mask or away from the altar, you have to blacken it again.
Keep the masks from the *Fafnar's Wrath* mission: they open the doors of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs|Kilmaresh Catacombs}, where {creature:Sister Hetai}'s portal is.

Everything takes place on the island of {wiki:Kilmaresh|Kilmaresh}, whose capital is **Issavi**. There are boats to Issavi from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond**: talk to the harbour captain and say {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, in the harbour **north** of the city (1 floor above ground). Alternatively, use the magic carpet from any city with that service: you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform, at the highest point of Issavi.
2. Base outfit — Wanted mission: find the innocent one

The base outfit is the reward for the **Wanted** mission of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest|Kilmaresh Quest}. Eshaya is looking for four fugitives, but one of them is innocent: first you find out which one with a ritual, then you defeat the other three.

Go to the building **north of the market** in Issavi and go up **one floor**. Talk to {npc:Eshaya}: say {key:hi}, {key:wanted} and accept with {key:yes}. There are four wanted people (Amenef, Neferi, Petaris and Hetai), but one of them may be innocent, and Eshaya sends you to talk to {npc:Kallimae}.

Go to the building just **east of the depot** and go up **two floors**. Say {key:hi} and {key:wanted} to {npc:Kallimae}. She explains the ritual: get a **golden** hand mirror (a silver one will not do), blacken it in fire and, at the shrine of Suon (on the coast **north-west** of Issavi), scrape off the soot while wearing an **ivory mask**.
Kallimae talks about reciting a phrase and naming the four suspects, but the wiki spoiler only lists equipping the mask and scraping the mirror at the altar as the steps of the ritual.

If you still have the {item:Ivory Mask} from the *Fafnar's Wrath* mission of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest|Kilmaresh Quest}, use that one. If not, go to the **Library** in Issavi's palace and use a {item:Small Emerald} on the Ornamented Ankh there to get a new {item:Ivory Mask}.
Library (Ornamented Ankh for the Ivory Mask)
The Ivory Mask also opens the doors leading into the centre of the Kilmaresh Catacombs from the **south**, where Sister Hetai's portal is. Do not throw it away.
Get to the Ruins of Nuur

The {wiki:Ruins of Nuur|Ruins of Nuur} are **beneath** Kilmaresh, **south/south-west** of Issavi (location at {coord:33808,31694,8}, 1 floor below ground). The wiki does not describe the walking route from Issavi or the exact entrance: open the coordinate on the map to find your way. If you have already completed **all** the missions of the Kilmaresh Quest (for example, when you come back to repeat the bosses), you can use the **Nykri Delta** shortcut ({coord:33809,31506,7}), which takes you straight to the ruins ({coord:33777,31710,7}).
Nykri Delta shortcut (only with the Kilmaresh Quest complete)

The ruins are a hunting area for level 300+, with {creature:Venerable Girtablilu|Venerable Girtablilus} and {creature:Girtablilu Warrior|Girtablilu Warriors}.
Inside the ruins, go down to floor z=10 (3 floors below ground) and go to a small room to the **east**. Open the **Ornate Case** and take the {item:Golden Hand Mirror}.
Ornate Case with the Golden Hand Mirror

Go back up the same way you came down to the surface and return to Issavi, to the **north**. If you came in through the Nykri Delta shortcut, go back to the spot where you arrived ({coord:33777,31710,7}); the wiki does not say whether the shortcut also works in the opposite direction.
In Issavi, use the {item:Golden Hand Mirror} on a {item:Fire Bowl} (any one in the city will do). The mirror becomes a {item:Blackened Hand Mirror}.
Go to the shrine of Suon (Nykri Delta)
Leave Issavi to the **west**, to the **Nykri Delta**, where {npc:Taya} is. Go up to the shrine of Suon, on the coast.

**Equip the {item:Ivory Mask}** and, at the altar in front of the statue of the Benevolent King, use the {item:Secret Agent Tools|Secret Agent Tool} (or the {item:Obsidian Knife}) on the {item:Blackened Hand Mirror}. The message *"A young woman's face appears in the mirror and a voice seems to whisper into your ear: 'Petaris is innocent.'"* appears.

If you are not wearing the mask, or if you scrape the mirror away from the altar, you have to blacken it again in a Fire Bowl.
Head back **east** to Issavi, go up to {npc:Eshaya} and say {key:wanted}. He learns that Petaris is innocent and asks you to bring the other three to justice.
3. Base outfit — defeat the three fugitives (alone)

The three fugitives are bosses (**Archfoe** in the Bosstiary) that you must kill **alone**. Each one has its own portal and a **20-hour** cooldown. All of them detect invisibility, never flee and walk through fire, energy and poison fields. They are also the ones who drop the addon items (sections 4 and 5).
Get ready for three solo fights. They all attack mainly in melee and they are all weak to **ice**.
Melee up to 1000; summons 1 {creature:Skeleton Elite Warrior} (estimated max. damage 2265)
South of the Ruins of Nuur, {coord:33819,31773,10}
Go to Neferi the Spy's portal
{creature:Neferi the Spy}'s portal is in **Issavi harbour**, near {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, on the same floor (1 floor above ground). Go in alone.
Kill {creature:Neferi the Spy}. She hits up to 1000 in melee and summons a {creature:Skeleton Elite Warrior}. Use ice if you can (she takes 110%) and avoid death damage (only 80%).
She is the fugitive with the most health (28 000) and the one who deals the most damage when her summon also attacks you.

The wiki does not describe how to leave the boss room. After the fight, leave the room and return to Issavi harbour, where the portal is, next to {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat: you are already inside the city.
Get to the centre of the Kilmaresh Catacombs

The {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs|Kilmaresh Catacombs} lie beneath the **west** side of Issavi and are linked to the **Nykri Delta** by tunnels that come out on the steppe. The safest entrance is from the **north**, through the cave of the {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes} and {creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens}; the wiki does not give the coordinate of that entrance on the surface, only those of the doors down below. Sister Hetai's portal is in the **centre**, on floor z=9 (2 floors below ground). The doors to the centre are opened with the masks from the *Fafnar's Wrath* mission: from the **north** with the {item:Silver Mask}, from the **south** with the {item:Ivory Mask}. The first door next to the main entrance is opened with the {item:Mirror Mask}.
Northern doors of the centre (Silver Mask)
Southern doors of the centre (Ivory Mask)
First door next to the main entrance (Mirror Mask)

The catacombs are a hunting area for level 300+ (350+ for knights): {creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens}, {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes}, {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun|Priestesses of the Wild Sun}, {creature:Black Sphinx Acolyte|Black Sphinx Acolytes} and {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators}.
Enter the portal in the centre, alone, and kill {creature:Sister Hetai}. She only attacks in melee (up to 600). She is the weakest to ice (125%) and resists energy, fire and physical a little.

The wiki does not describe how to leave the boss room. After the fight, go back to the centre of the catacombs and retrace the way you came in (through the same doors and the northern cave, if you entered there) to the surface; the catacomb tunnels also come out on the steppe, on the Nykri Delta side. Then return to Issavi, to the **east**.
Get to Amenef the Burning's portal

Go back to the {wiki:Ruins of Nuur|Ruins of Nuur}, as you did to fetch the mirror (or through the Nykri Delta shortcut, if you have already completed all the missions of the Kilmaresh Quest). {creature:Amenef the Burning}'s portal is in the **southern** part of the ruins, on floor z=10 (3 floors below ground).
Enter the portal, alone, and kill {creature:Amenef the Burning}. He attacks in melee (up to 925). He takes 120% from ice and resists fire (85%) and energy (90%).

The wiki does not describe how to leave the boss room. After the fight, go back to the ruins and go up the same way you came down to the surface (or go back to the shortcut's arrival point, {coord:33777,31710,7}, if you came in that way). Then return to Issavi, to the **north**.
Hand in the mission to Eshaya

With all three dead, go back to {npc:Eshaya} (north of the market, 1 floor up) and report the mission (the wiki does not give the exact keyword; the mission is always handled with {key:wanted}). You receive the base {wiki:Citizen of Issavi Outfits|Citizen of Issavi Outfit}.
Official artwork of the Citizen of Issavi Outfits

No NPC sells or buys the {item:Eye-Embroidered Veil}. You have two options: loot it from one of the three fugitives (repeat the fights from section 3, each boss once every 20 hours) or buy it from another player on the **Market** (the item is tradeable).
Amenef has the highest chance of dropping the veil.
Use the {item:Eye-Embroidered Veil}. The message *"You are now allowed to wear an eye-embroidered veil together with your robes of an Issavi citizen!"* appears.

Like the veil, the {item:Tagralt-Inlaid Scabbard} is not sold or bought by NPCs. Either you loot it from one of the three fugitives, or you buy it from another player on the **Market**. It weighs 25 oz.
Here the best bet is Sister Hetai. With such low chances, the Market is usually the fastest route.
Use the {item:Tagralt-Inlaid Scabbard}. The message *"You are now allowed to wear a tagralt blade veil together with your robes of an Issavi citizen!"* appears.

Once you have **both** addons, you receive the **Citizen of Issavi** achievement (2 points): you may wear the robes of Kilmaresh, the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers, as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
Take the boat or the carpet

To leave the island, go to Issavi harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Harava}: say {key:hi}, the destination ({key:darashia}, {key:venore} or {key:krailos}, 80 gp each; {key:oramond}, 100 gp) and {key:yes}. Players who have completed the Postman Quest get a 10 gp discount on most destinations. You can also use {npc:Tanyt}'s magic carpet, at the highest point of the city.
This outfit quest **has no entry of its own in the Quest Log**.
The addon items only drop from the three fugitives of the Wanted mission ({creature:Neferi the Spy}, {creature:Sister Hetai} and {creature:Amenef the Burning}).

Description of the **Citizen of Issavi** achievement: it was not the first time you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task; now you may wear the robes of Kilmaresh, the tagralt blade and the seers' veil as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
The wiki does not document the exit from the three fugitives' rooms or the walking route to the entrances of the Ruins of Nuur and the Kilmaresh Catacombs; the guide only gives what is documented.

A version of these robes worn only by NPCs and creatures (such as {creature:Black Sphinx Acolyte} and {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun}) had existed since the Summer Update 2019; the outfit for players arrived with the Summer Update 2021.
